column2: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
column6: A man is whisked off Earth moments before it is demolished and tours the galaxy with an alien friend, meeting odd characters and one very depressed robot. It is a funny, absurd take on the meaning of life.
A young noble's family takes charge of a desert planet that holds the universe's most valuable resource. Betrayal forces him to survive among its people and grow into something much larger.
In a country where the government watches everyone and rewrites the past, one clerk quietly starts to think for himself. A warning about power, truth and control.
A mathematician predicts the fall of a galactic empire and sets up a small group to shorten the dark age that follows. The story follows the crises that group faces over the centuries.
Linked stories about the early days of robots, told by a robot psychologist. Each one tests how a few simple rules for machines can go wrong in surprising ways.
An astronaut is left behind on Mars and has to grow food, fix equipment and stay cheerful until anyone can rescue him. Problem solving and jokes in equal measure.
A young scientist creates a living being and then abandons it in horror. The creature's search for belonging raises hard questions about responsibility.
An accessible tour of black holes, the Big Bang and the nature of time, written for readers with no physics background.
A sweeping journey through the universe and the history of human curiosity about it, from ancient astronomers to space probes.
A short history of humankind, from early hunters to modern societies, asking how stories and shared beliefs let strangers cooperate at scale.
A summer on Long Island in the 1920s, seen through a neighbour of a mysterious millionaire who throws lavish parties in the hope of winning back a lost love.
A practical guide to writing code that other people can read and change, with many before-and-after examples of tidying up messy programs.
